source_snapshot.procedure: At the BMC console create `/tmp/gpu_caution2`, verify simulated 104 C GPU SDR plus alert/error evidence, then after 60 seconds verify UBB power LED loss and OS shutdown; remove the marker and perform an AC cycle to verify recovery.
source_snapshot.criteria: A temporary key log must exist before marker removal.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/CONFLICTING; repeats the marker sequence through insecure remote SSH, uses unrelated ROCm benchmark metadata and cannot prove physical LED/power or AC-cycle behavior.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires vendor-confirmed non-heating injection, BMC/power operator, persistent evidence and explicit recovery.

old_problem: The prior record gated execution but did not isolate the irreducible private-interface blocker. No public authority defines caution2, the controller filesystem, its 104 C mapping, the 60-second shutdown policy or safe marker removal after host power loss.
disposition_reason: Unlike caution1, this private OEM injection intentionally transitions the platform through a delayed shutdown and subsequent AC recovery. ED-03 forbids guessing the marker/controller semantics, ED-06/ED-18 require the exact shutdown and AC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready phases, ED-09 keeps LED/AC work manual, ED-16 requires approved injection/recovery, and ED-17 preserves SEL evidence. A standard Linux `touch`, IPMI query or guessed 60-second sleep cannot authorize this destructive power-policy test.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row414 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3006, same-code row149 and adjacent row415 caution3 case.
Kept same-code row149 device-to-device TransferBench saturation independent from this caution2 power-policy variant.
Separated the required externally observable phases: 104 C injection, critical event, 60-second delayed shutdown, UBB LED loss, marker cleanup, AC OFF/ON and POST/OS/GPU/BMC recovery.
Rejected host-only tail output because host evidence cannot persist reliably across the intended shutdown, and rejected log clearing per ED-17.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row415 and verified its manifest identity; no marker, shutdown, AC cycle or DUT/BMC action ran.

test_case.test_name: OEM-approved caution2 synthetic 104 C delayed shutdown and AC recovery
test_case.purpose: Inject the exact approved caution2 condition and prove the target firmware records the 104 C critical state, performs its specified delayed shutdown with UBB LED transition, then recovers completely after marker cleanup and an authorized AC cycle.
required_package: Wistron-controlled caution2 specification for the exact BMC/controller, firmware build, marker path/ownership/mode and state machine
Approved SDR sensor/value/tolerance, SEL/host event IDs, 60-second timing tolerance, orderly-shutdown signature and UBB LED source/state
Qualified BMC/power operator, external timestamped BMC/LED/AC evidence recorder and drained maintenance window
Safe post-shutdown marker-removal method, AC-cycle procedure, POST/OS/eight-GPU/BMC health oracle and recovery owner
test_case.test_command: PENDING OEM AUTHORITY. After written approval and workload drain, preserve SDR/SEL/dmesg/fan/power baseline and start external logging. A qualified operator creates the exact approved caution2 marker once at the specified BMC console. Record the mapped 104 C state, exact critical events, elapsed time to orderly OS shutdown and UBB power LED loss. Using the vendor-approved out-of-band cleanup path, verify marker removal before the separately authorized AC OFF then AC ON sequence; observe POST, OS Ready, all mapped GPUs and BMC health.
test_case.expected_result: The approved synthetic sensor alone reports 104 C and emits the specified temporary key/critical evidence. Shutdown and UBB LED transition occur in the approved order and within the signed 60-second tolerance. The marker is proven absent before AC-on, and the complete AC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready recovery returns BMC, host and all GPUs healthy without a shutdown loop or residual fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PENDING: PASS is forbidden until OEM authority defines the marker, sensor/events, timing tolerance, shutdown/LED signature, cleanup and AC recovery. After approval every phase and independent artifact must match; a 65-second sleep, host log tail or successful reboot alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Prove caution2 is a supported non-heating injection for the exact BMC firmware and approve intentional shutdown/AC impact
Drain workloads and filesystems; preserve SEL/dmesg and log externally before marker creation
Provide qualified BMC/power operator, exact AC controls, independent management and a verified marker-removal path while host is down
Stop on wrong sensor/event/timing/order, real thermal/power anomaly, cleanup uncertainty or management loss; do not auto-retry or repeat the AC cycle
expected_evidence: Signed OEM caution2/controller/firmware and shutdown/recovery specification
Before/during marker state, 104 C SDR identity, complete SEL/host events and synchronized external timeline
Orderly shutdown evidence, UBB LED visual evidence and AC rail/state timestamps
Marker absence before AC-on and one authorized OFF-to-ON transition
POST, OS Ready, all-GPU/BMC post-health and operator/engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Use only the OEM-approved out-of-band path to remove the marker and prove the injected state is clear before applying AC. If cleanup, shutdown order or health is wrong, preserve evidence and escalate without another cycle. Execute controlled service recovery only under the signed procedure; never clear SEL or retry automatically.
